name: exec_release_ball_up
description: Release mode: throw ball up-right. Player should NOT be yanked (released chain). Shackle must stay within chain radius of ball.
script: # Spawn executioner in Release mode at center floor
# Query chain length (+20 margin) so verify radius tracks config changes
# Player must stay put — Release mode means no YEET on the player
announce Release mode: throwing ball up-right
# Throw at ~60 deg up-right. 1.5s hold = full charge
# Wait for throw to fire before starting chain-radius verify
# Shackle must stay within total chain length of the ball at all times
# chain_radius = exec_chain_total_len + 20px buffer for physics jitter
# Let physics settle — ball bounces, shackle gets yanked, both come to rest
